data.one_liner: A set of strict lint rules for Dart projects.
data.what_it_does: Lintorium provides a set of strict lint rules for Dart. It maintains an identically configured ruleset across every supported Dart SDK version.
use_when: You want strict and consistent lint rules across different Dart SDK versions in your projects.
You want the same rules and analyzer behavior across projects on different Dart SDK versions.
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter or Dart lints without strict rules.
strengths: Keeps the same ruleset configured identically across every supported Dart SDK version.
Compatible with both Dart and Flutter projects.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration and customization if certain rules are not desired.
data.setup_notes: Add dev_dependencies: lintorium to pubspec.yaml and include package:lintorium/analysis_options.yaml in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter lint rules recommended for Flutter projects.
